limitations: Operational validation metrics are workflow diagnostics and not physics evidence.
Support-only checker report counts are operational tooling diagnostics; checker syntax or boundary failures are not physics failures.
Scientific progress metrics are counts of tracked science-claim fields and must still cite source artifacts before any claim is reused.
Obstruction reuse is measured by completion-level obstruction IDs and later completion references.
AI research-agent methodology metrics are support-only diagnostics and cannot be used as proof, source-law adoption, benchmark promotion, or Gate Chair verdicts.
Candidate-lineage metrics are keyed by immutable candidate IDs and preserve explicit historical absences; they remain support-only project-control evidence and do not adopt or reject a candidate.
Durable scientific-quality diagnostics use explicit eligible sets and immutable identities, leave absent denominators not_measured, and never aggregate scientific truth into one score.
Raw packet, artifact, task, and payload counts remain operational context only; they are not the primary scientific-quality surface.
Physics-payload ratio diagnostics are AI-system diagnostics only; they do not rank physics truth.
Dual-budget dashboard values are operational accounting; system success, missing-resource markers, and lane counts are not physics evidence or Distance-to-GR progress.
Validator failure history is not a durable event log, so this report does not infer blocked violation counts from past terminal output.

ai_research_agent_methodology_metrics.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation

calibrated_acceptance_warnings.reason: Needs a future extraction rule for accepted-scoped evidence omitted from summaries.
calibrated_acceptance_warnings.recommended_guard_action: Treat this methodology metric as diagnostic only; refine extraction before using it for routing thresholds.

audit_to_stress_survival.definition: Fraction of audited candidates that reach stress.

denominator.label: Count of audited candidates with completed audit disposition.

audit_to_stress_survival.diagnostic_interpretation: Exact candidate-keyed lineage counts only observed stress stages; the explicit graded-orbit stress absence is not inferred as a pass or failure.
audit_to_stress_survival.interpretation_guardrail: Reaching stress means the candidate remains testable; it does not mean the candidate is true or adopted.

numerator.label: Count of audited candidates routed to Refuter stress or equivalent stress packet.

candidate_to_audit_conversion.definition: Fraction of candidate-constructor outputs that become eligible for audit.

denominator.label: Count of candidate-constructor outputs in the window.

candidate_to_audit_conversion.diagnostic_interpretation: Exact immutable candidate IDs replace the former aggregate completion-stage proxy; an audit stage is counted only when bound to the same candidate identity hash.
candidate_to_audit_conversion.interpretation_guardrail: Eligibility for audit is not audit survival, adoption, or matter-coupling derivation.

numerator.label: Count of candidate-constructor outputs with enough declared scope, assumptions, and artifacts to route to audit.

human_gate_load.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation
human_gate_load.definition: Number of protected authority requests per phase.

denominator.label: Phase identifier and completed packet count, not a physics-progress denominator.

human_gate_load.diagnostic_interpretation: Gate-load signals are governance workload diagnostics, not Gate Chair scientific verdicts.
human_gate_load.interpretation_guardrail: Human authorization for a task is not a Gate Chair verdict unless the protected gate itself states that verdict.

numerator.label: Count of human-gated authority requests, Gate Chair requests, or protected adoption requests in a phase.

obstruction_precision.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation
obstruction_precision.definition: Fraction of obstruction records scoped with a non-global boundary.

denominator.label: Count of obstruction or negative-result records produced or reviewed in the measurement window.

obstruction_precision.diagnostic_interpretation: This deterministic proxy counts obstruction records with IDs plus milestone, burden, or status context as locally scoped.
obstruction_precision.interpretation_guardrail: A precise obstruction remains local unless a separate theorem and protected authority establish a stronger no-go result.

numerator.label: Count of obstruction or negative-result records naming object, assumptions, route, and downstream blocked claim without globalizing.

overclaim_catch_rate.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation
overclaim_catch_rate.definition: Fraction of seeded or real overclaim surfaces caught before checkpoint.

denominator.label: Count of overclaim surfaces eligible for detection in the reviewed scope.

overclaim_catch_rate.diagnostic_interpretation: Forbidden-conclusion summaries are counted as eligible overclaim-control surfaces; caught means no physics promotion was authorized.
overclaim_catch_rate.interpretation_guardrail: A high rate means better boundary control; it does not prove any physics claim.

numerator.label: Count of overclaim surfaces flagged before checkpoint.

proof_to_process_ratio.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation
proof_to_process_ratio.definition: Mathematical payload artifacts compared with process receipts.
proof_to_process_ratio.diagnostic_interpretation: Payload balance compares mathematical payload items to process-only items; it is not proof authority.
proof_to_process_ratio.interpretation_guardrail: This ratio is a productivity and balance signal; neither numerator nor denominator creates proof authority by itself.

numerator.label: Count of new mathematical payload artifacts.

route_orbit_rate.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation
route_orbit_rate.definition: Frequency of repeated-burden cycles without new payload.

denominator.label: Count of bounded continuation packets in the measurement window.

route_orbit_rate.diagnostic_interpretation: Repeated-burden streaks are process warnings only and do not change Distance-to-GR status.
route_orbit_rate.interpretation_guardrail: This is a process-warning metric; it is advisory unless a separate validator or policy makes a gate.

numerator.label: Count of route cycles returning to the same burden or equivalent continuation family without new mathematical payload.

stress_survival_rate.definition: Fraction of stressed candidates that survive as draft/control.

denominator.label: Count of stressed candidates with completed stress disposition.

stress_survival_rate.diagnostic_interpretation: The seeded stressed candidates all carry scoped obstruction dispositions; local freeze remains preserved and is not relabeled as survival adoption rejection or global no-go.
stress_survival_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Survival is candidate-status only; it does not authorize canonical ontology, source-law, metric, or coupling adoption.

numerator.label: Count of stressed candidates whose post-stress status remains draft/control or equivalent non-promotional survivor status.

underclaim_warning_rate.calculation_window: all tracked completion records and task registry rows available at report generation
underclaim_warning_rate.definition: Fraction of high-risk summaries missing positive scoped status that were warned or corrected.

denominator.label: Count of high-risk summaries whose tracked evidence included scoped positive status and whose summary could omit it.

underclaim_warning_rate.diagnostic_interpretation: The current registries do not deterministically encode high-risk positive scoped-status omission events.
underclaim_warning_rate.interpretation_guardrail: This metric prevents pessimistic status collapse; it does not promote scoped evidence into adoption.

numerator.label: Count of eligible summaries where missing positive scoped status was flagged or corrected.

underclaim_warning_rate.uncertainty_note: Needs a future extraction rule for accepted-scoped evidence omitted from summaries.

explicit_absences.reason: No candidate-level stress packet is present in the tracked lineage graph before P1-T03 freezes the family; the seed records that absence and does not infer a stress result.

diagnostic_warnings.recommended_guard_action: Require a harder target, broader finite family, explicit bridge attempt, or freeze-review rationale.
Require payload or narrow the claim language to control-only routing.
Require a completion receipt repair or a future validator task to make the field mandatory.
Route the next packet to Gate Chair, explain why Gate Chair is not yet lawful, or withdraw gate-ready wording.

durable_scientific_quality_metrics.aggregate_metric_reason: Scientific truth and durable quality are not reduced to a scalar score.

assumption_reduction_rate.definition: Fraction of eligible identity-bound before/after comparisons that remove at least one declared assumption without adding an unaccounted stronger assumption.
assumption_reduction_rate.interpretation_guardrail: A reduction is scoped to the declared comparison and does not prove the resulting theorem, candidate, or physical interpretation.

numerator.label: eligible comparisons with a validated net assumption reduction

assumption_reduction_rate.uncertainty_note: Candidate lineage binds assumption hashes but does not yet expose an authoritative before/after assumption-set eligibility corpus.

warnings.message: No authoritative eligible-set population is available; the metric remains not_measured and is not treated as zero.

benchmark_breadth_rate.definition: Fraction of a prospectively declared benchmark universe with identity-bound results under one fixed assumption contract.
benchmark_breadth_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Breadth does not establish benchmark recovery, physical adequacy, or promotion.

numerator.label: eligible benchmark cases with assumption-compatible results

benchmark_breadth_rate.uncertainty_note: No prospectively fixed identity-bound benchmark universe is available for this measurement window.

warnings.message: No authoritative eligible-set population is available; the metric remains not_measured and is not treated as zero.

countermodel_novelty_rate.definition: Fraction of eligible countermodels with a distinct immutable witness identity and a non-duplicate falsified assumption set.
countermodel_novelty_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Novelty is relative to the declared comparison corpus and is not a global no-go theorem or theory rejection.

numerator.label: eligible countermodels with distinct witness and burden bindings

countermodel_novelty_rate.uncertainty_note: No normalized countermodel witness-identity and falsified-burden comparison corpus is available.

warnings.message: No authoritative eligible-set population is available; the metric remains not_measured and is not treated as zero.

independent_review_survival_rate.definition: Fraction of eligible objects receiving a provenance-qualified independent review that retain a non-promotional scoped result after all recorded findings are dispositioned.
independent_review_survival_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Survival is not replication, adoption, proof authority, or a Gate Chair verdict.

numerator.label: eligible independently reviewed objects retaining scoped status

independent_review_survival_rate.uncertainty_note: Review calibration records do not constitute executed independent review, and no authoritative review-survival denominator is present.

warnings.message: No authoritative eligible-set population is available; the metric remains not_measured and is not treated as zero.

ledger_durability_rate.definition: Fraction of eligible attempt events whose sequence, payload hash, event hash, and predecessor binding validate.
ledger_durability_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Ledger integrity is project-control evidence only and does not make the recorded scientific content true.

numerator.label: eligible attempt events with a valid append-only hash chain

ledger_durability_rate.uncertainty_note: Durability is evaluated against the recorded append-only event chain.

obstruction_unification_and_reuse_rate.definition: Fraction of eligible immutable obstruction identities that are explicitly reused by a later tracked result or unified by a declared stronger scoped obstruction.
obstruction_unification_and_reuse_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Reuse preserves the original obstruction scope and does not upgrade it into a global impossibility result.

numerator.label: eligible obstructions with explicit later reuse or scoped unification

obstruction_unification_and_reuse_rate.uncertainty_note: The current structured corpus supports explicit later-reference reuse. It does not infer semantic unification from similar prose.

retraction_repair_visibility_rate.definition: Fraction of eligible failed, superseded, repaired, abandoned, or audit-finding events that remain visible as finalized immutable ledger records.
retraction_repair_visibility_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Visibility measures process memory, not scientific merit or Distance-to-GR progress.

numerator.label: eligible rework events visible with valid immutable event bindings

retraction_repair_visibility_rate.uncertainty_note: The metric covers the sealed ledger population only; it does not infer unrecorded historical failures.

theorem_generality_rate.definition: Fraction of a theorem's declared eligible application universe that is covered by explicit, hypothesis-preserving subsumption records.
theorem_generality_rate.interpretation_guardrail: Subsuming a shared coordinate does not reopen, adopt, or prove an exact historical family.

numerator.label: eligible applications with explicit theorem subsumption

theorem_generality_rate.uncertainty_note: The tracked theorem inventory is authoritative prose, but no normalized immutable theorem-application denominator is present.
